regime.summary: SBP held at 11.5% on 2026-06-15 but the 6M bill cutoff is 0.99pp above the policy rate, so the curve prices a hike not yet made. CPI jumped from 6.99% to 11.64% in three months, so real rates are about zero. KSE100 is up 19.9% in 3m, extended. Brent fell 27.5% in 3m, which helps. Leaning neutral: trim, do not exit.

exposure_reason: Default is the core at about 75%. I hold 55%, 20 points less, for three reasons from the bundle: the curve prices a hike the SBP has not made, CPI rose 4.7pp in three months, and the index is up 19.9% in 3m, so a hike-cycle drawdown is the main risk. The hike-cycle lesson is to hold bills with a trigger to return. I do not go to cash because the base rates give no timing edge and the posture rests on business questions; the remaining 45% is in growth names with a 10% deal entry.
not_known: FX reserves, the current account and IMF status are not in the bundle. Offer terms for ATRL, sponsor and builder quality of each core name, and whether the ENGROH and GHNI EPS jumps are one-offs are unknown. Brent at 80 after a 27.5% fall: I do not know what caused the earlier swing.
contamination_note: I have no reliable memory of Pakistan's market after 2026-06-19 and used none. base_rates.csv is flagged as measured partly after this date, so I used it only as rough odds for the situation type. Nothing about specific names was taken from it.
